content: AI companion apps (Replika, Character.AI) draw sustained privacy/creepiness backlash when the app appears to 'know too much' or probes for intimate detail unprompted; CHI 2025 taxonomy of harmful algorithmic behaviors and multiple surveys show users' privacy concern peaks around unprompted probing questions, memory of vulnerable disclosures, and uncertainty about who can access chat logs — heavy users skew toward people with existing mental-health vulnerability, raising the stakes of getting tone wrong.
